blocks.text: Original document: [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

Retiam is a high-performance, WebGPU-powered animation engine designed for creating programmatic, mathematical, and cinematic animations. It draws inspiration from Manim but leverages the power of modern GPUs via WebGPU for real-time rendering and complex compute tasks.
The `Scene` class is the central coordinator. It manages the `Renderer`, `Camera`, and the collection of `Entity` objects.

items: **Renderer**: Handles WebGPU device initialization, pipeline management, and the frame loop.

blocks.text: Everything rendered in Retiam is an `Entity`.

items: **Base Entity**: Provides transform (position, rotation, scale) and visibility state.
**2D Entities**: Shapes (Circle, Square), Paths (SVG), Text (SDF and Canvas-based), and Math (LaTeX via KaTeX/MathJax).

blocks.text: Animations are handled by `Animator` and `Animation` classes.

items: **Group Animations**: Sequencing and parallel execution of multiple animations.
**Timeline**: Manages the playback state and time-based progression.
